name: Bluesky
summary:
Bluesky is the social app at bsky.app. The butterfly tab icon is what that host publishes for the web client, and the measurements below come from those bytes.

Checked 12 November 2026 against bsky.app. HTML came from https://bsky.app/ (HTTP 200). Icon link tags: apple-touch-icon 180x180 → https://web-cdn.bsky.app/static/apple-touch-icon.png; icon 32x32 → https://web-cdn.bsky.app/static/favicon-32x32.png; icon 16x16 → https://web-cdn.bsky.app/static/favicon-16x16.png; mask-icon → https://web-cdn.bsky.app/static/safari-pinned-tab.svg.

No favicon.ico URL returned an image on 12 November 2026. bsky.app did not pass the image check for an .ico path. Formats that did save: png, svg.

The apple-touch-icon URL is https://web-cdn.bsky.app/static/apple-touch-icon.png, measured at 180×180 png.

Brand colour #1185fe comes from the mask-icon color attribute.

Largest measured bitmap: svg-04.svg at 512×512 (svg, 1987 bytes) from https://web-cdn.bsky.app/static/safari-pinned-tab.svg.

files.dimensionNote: SVG viewBox user units, not a pixel bitmap
